publisher: State, district and territory legislatures and code revisers (official statute text)
table: Nonpayment eviction steps: pay-or-quit notice, cure, hearing and stay
title: Eviction steps read from each place's statute text, Oct 23, 2026 pass
universe: Residential tenancies evicted for nonpayment of rent
geography: 56 places keyed by postal code (50 states, DC, PR, GU, VI, AS, MP)
limits: Every value is the law in force on the game's opening day, January 20, 2025 (inForceOnOpening says how that was confirmed); laterLaw lists dated changes that take effect after it, which the engine does not read yet. Each Oct 23 row quotes the fetched statute text (apostrophes and line breaks normalized). readOct12 lists the fields an earlier pass confirmed from official text (data/research/housing/eviction-steps-2026.json, verifiedFields). basis 'absence' means the chapter was read and has no such provision (no notice period, or no tender or cure section). A stay is the days after judgment at which the law has the household removed: the minimum wait where the statute sets one, else the officer's deadline. Fields under 'secondary' still come from secondary summaries or the median of the read places, for the reason given. Day types (business, court) are recorded; the engine counts calendar days.
